tools.name: blinkde_list_employees
tools.description: List employees of the Blink system (number, name, entry and leaving date, time tracking mode, cost centre). OData: GET /odata/v2/Employees.

tools.name: blinkde_get_employee
tools.description: Get one employee by id. OData: GET /odata/v2/Employees({id}).

tools.name: blinkde_list_locations
tools.description: List locations (objects or sites where work is done): name, number, active flag, coordinates, planning mode. OData: GET /odata/v2/Locations.

tools.name: blinkde_get_location
tools.description: Get one location by id. OData: GET /odata/v2/Locations({id}).

tools.name: blinkde_get_worklog
tools.description: Get one time record (worklog) by id. OData: GET /odata/v2/WorklogModels({id}).

tools.name: blinkde_list_planning_entries
tools.description: List planning entries (shift plans) with their dates, locations and planned durations. OData: GET /odata/v2/PlanningEntries.
